_note:
SEED REFERENCE DATA ONLY. Approximate public leaderboard / model-card values (5-shot MMLU/MMLU-Pro, 8-shot CoT GSM8K, 0-shot GPQA/AIME24/ARC/HellaSwag, pass@1 HumanEval(+)/LiveCodeBench, strict IFEval) used to bootstrap expectation curves. Values are rounded, not exact; replace via the ingestion pipeline before production use. null = not recorded in seed.

2026 additions (22 benchmarks total): MATH-500 / AIME-2025 / FrontierMath (math), BigCodeBench-Instruct-FULL / Terminal-Bench 1.0 (code/agentic), SimpleQA (factuality), MMMU (vision), LongBench V2 (long-context). Most values are verified against primary sources (arXiv reports, model cards, official leaderboards) by web research on 2026-08-14; values for the seed's 2026-era models (deepseek-v3.2/v4-pro/v4-flash, glm-4.6, qwen3-coder-480b, qwen3.6-27b) without public scores are internally-consistent estimates. BigCodeBench uses only the Instruct-FULL split; Terminal-Bench uses only v1.0 (aime25 / frontiermath columns are reasoning-mode / frontier-only and sparse).
